projects.title: Smart Air Quality Monitoring System
projects.role: Final-Year Project Team Member (Development, Hardware Prototyping, Testing & Technical Documentation)
projects.description: An end-to-end IoT-based environmental intelligence system engineered to measure hazardous air pollutants in real time, persist historical telemetry to cloud platforms, and deliver actionable threshold-based alerts to mobile and web endpoints.
projects.problem: Poor ambient and indoor air quality poses severe respiratory health risks, yet real-time, localized pollutant telemetry remains unavailable in most residential and municipal settings due to the high cost of industrial monitoring stations.
projects.purpose: To architect an accessible, low-cost, accurate IoT air monitoring station using modular gas sensors and microcontroller telemetry, enabling autonomous pollutant tracking, cloud data aggregation, and instant mobile alerts.
features: Autonomous multi-sensor data acquisition and ADC calibration
Real-time wireless telemetry transmission over Wi-Fi
Cloud storage and historical data charting on ThingSpeak
Live mobile dashboard for instantaneous readings
Programmable visual/buzzer and push notification threshold alerts
Modular embedded hardware architecture adaptable for indoor or outdoor deployment

projects.title: IoT Cloud Ingestion & AWS EC2 Infrastructure
projects.description: A cloud integration architecture connecting distributed IoT sensor telemetry with Amazon Web Services (AWS) Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2) virtual infrastructure for centralized ingestion, processing, and log archiving.
projects.problem: Bridging edge IoT sensor readings with scalable cloud infrastructure requires secure network provisioning, virtual server configuration, and reliable communication pipelines.
projects.purpose: To gain rigorous hands-on competence in deploying cloud virtual instances, establishing firewall security groups, and routing sensor telemetry into scalable cloud backend services.
features: Provisioned and configured cloud virtual servers on AWS EC2
Implemented secure inbound/outbound networking rules and security groups
Established automated logging pipeline for incoming telemetry data packets
Demonstrated scalable end-to-end pipeline from physical sensor to cloud instance

projects.title: Multi-VLAN Enterprise Network Architecture Simulation
projects.description: A simulated enterprise campus network designed and configured in Cisco Packet Tracer, incorporating hierarchical multi-layer switching, VLAN segmentation, inter-VLAN routing, NAT, and DHCP
projects.problem: Unsegmented enterprise networks suffer from excessive broadcast traffic, security vulnerabilities across departmental boundaries, and lack of redundant routing paths.
projects.purpose: To design an enterprise network topology delivering high availability, deterministic traffic routing, access control security, and efficient IP address allocation.
features: Hierarchical 3-tier enterprise campus design (Core, Distribution, Access)
Isolated departmental broadcast domains using 802.1Q tagged VLANs
Dynamic IP assignment via multi-pool DHCP server configuration
Secure external WAN connectivity with Overloaded NAT (PAT)
Traffic filtering and perimeter protection via Standard and Extended ACLs

keyContributions: Participated in cellular network planning and optimization across 2G, 3G, 4G, and 5G cellular technologies
Conducted drive test data collection and RF diagnostics using TEMS Investigation software
Analyzed key performance indicators (KPIs) including Call Drop Rate (CDR), Handover Success Rate (HOSR), and throughput metrics using MAPS
Utilized Google Earth Pro and MapInfo GIS software for base transceiver station (BTS) site planning, coordinate plotting, and coverage azimuth verification
Gained direct exposure to telecommunications transmission systems, microwave links, and cellular antenna tilt optimizations
